notes.title: Customization, Tattoos & Performance Boost!
notes.notes:
👋 [b]Hey everyone![/b]
As you know, we have big ambitions and a strong desire to create the game we’ve always dreamed of. There’s still a lot of work ahead, and the final big update will take some time. But we don’t want to leave you hanging — so we’ve put together an intermediate update with features that both you and we have been eagerly waiting for.

No more preludes — here’s what’s new:

[h2]💃CUSTO—WAIT FOR IT—MIZATION! 🎨[/h2] 
We’ve added full [b]body customization[/b] for the girl character. Now you get to decide the size of her boobs and butt, and whether she’s wearing a dress… or not.
Oh, and yes — she can now be barefoot!!! But the hood stays — after all, she’s still Little Red Riding Hood.

🖋️ [b]Also, tattoos have arrived[/b] — for now in test mode. So if you’ve always imagined Red as a jacked girl covered in ink, it’s the perfect time to check out the update!

In the future, we plan to expand tattoo options and give players the ability to upload their own designs and share them with the community.

[h2]⚙️ Visuals & Optimization[/h2] 
Every update brings [b]visual improvements[/b] — and this one is no exception. We've refined the level design and optimized most of the scene’s objects.

We also made a bunch of adjustments directly in UE 5.5, aiming for smoother performance, even on low-end PCs.

The optimization didn’t stop with the environment — it affected the characters too. All materials were rebuilt with performance in mind, and cloth physics now run three times faster.

[h3]And a few more nice little things[/h3]
We improved the UI, fixed the camera, and tweaked dozens of small details.
But we’ve covered the essentials — and we don’t want to overload you with a wall of text before you jump back into the game. We really hope you enjoy the update!

As with every CatchMe update, we don’t have tons of resources for full-scale testing. But usually, a couple of days after release are enough for us to fix the most important bugs.

If you run into any issues — please let us know via the feedback section on our Steam community page. It really helps! 💬

And of course — we’re incredibly grateful for your reviews on Steam.
If you enjoyed the update, please consider leaving a positive review. It helps more players discover the game and gives our team a big morale boost!

notes.title: Technical Fixes & Gameplay Adjustments
notes.notes:
What’s new:

🎮 Gameplay Adjustments
[list]
[*] Added a tutorial screen on first launch to help new players understand the game.
[*] You can now look back while running – press the left mouse button to glance behind you.
[*] Fixed climbing issues in the starting area – certain surfaces where the player had trouble climbing walls have been adjusted. This also resulted in minor visual and level design changes.
[/list]
🔧 Technical Fixes & Improvements
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where baskets would respawn in the background during sex scenes.
[*] Mouse sensitivity and inversion settings now work correctly.
[*] Added a graphics settings button that automatically applies optimized settings for stable FPS.
[*] Fixed a bug where the results screen always displayed "New Record".
[*] Fixed an issue where the game failed to find the starting point after the second round.
[*] ESC now correctly closes the results screen.
[*] Pause now works during sex scenes.
[/list]

We noticed that some players were able to use a bug to achieve unusually high scores on the leaderboard. To keep things fair, we’ve removed these results. If you find a bug that allows unfair scoring or encounter any other issue, please report it in the Bug Reports section. Your feedback helps us improve the game and ensure a fair experience for everyone.

notes.title: Catch Me is Now Available in Early Access! 🎉
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Catch Me has officially launched in Early Access! This is a huge milestone for us, and we couldn't have done it without your support.

What’s Included in Early Access?
[list]
[*]Core gameplay mechanics – running, jumping, climbing, pursuer, sex scenes, a bonus system, and leaderboard.
[*]A large map with beautiful landscapes.
[*]Motion Matching animation technology for realistic character movement.
[*]Advanced cloth simulation.
[*]Smart pursuer AI that observes, analyzes player routes, and plans the best way to catch the player (though it’s still far from perfect).
[*]Good performance, even on Steam Deck.
[/list]

What We’re Planning
[list]
[*]Expansion of the current level with new mechanics.
[*]Greater variety and depth in intimate scenes.
[*]Realistic simulation of soft body physics.
[*]Performance improvements.
[*]The ability to choose outfits, accessories, anal plugs, and other intimate toys.
[*]Multiplayer
[*]Ability to play as the pursuer in solo mode
[*]Gameplay enhancements based on community feedback.
[/list]

We are developing Catch Me with no budget, no advertising, and no industry connections. We rely entirely on word of mouth and your support. If you like the direction Catch Me is heading, please share information about the game on your social media and tell your friends—it's our only chance to get noticed.
